summary: This informational document is a product of the Path Aware Networking Research Group. It catalogs and analyzes earlier attempts to develop and deploy path aware networking techniques, most of which were unsuccessful or only partly successful, to draw lessons for researchers working on such systems today.

eli5.summary: Sometimes you want to pick your own road across the Internet instead of letting the map choose. This document looks at many past tries at that, explains why most did not catch on, and shares lessons.

questions: obstacles to deploying path aware networking
